requirement: v3.3.5: end-of-turn single/multi choice prompts (1/2/3/4 or A/B/C/D) must be mirrored into the decision center as pending choices with notifications, and the bottom status bar must show the fleet machine ratio and the online-fleets ratio

assertions.choice_parser: parseChoiceOptions handles numbered (1./1、), lettered (A./B、) and keyless checkbox ([ ]/☐/☑) option blocks at the end of an assistant message, plus single-line inline choices; plain prose and single options return null
assertions.choice_watcher: installChoiceWatcher polls the active session last assistant/message every 5s via the client sessions service, dedupes by session+question+options hash (localStorage w2m:choice:seen:v1), and POSTs a yellow SuperAgent/superagent-completion ticket to /api/w2m/decisions/ingest with the parsed options, then refreshes the decision store (badge/toast)
assertions.answer_feedback: picking an option in the decision center resolves the ticket and writes the option label into the composer, so the user sends the answer back into the conversation
assertions.status_bar: the bottom bar shows 本编队在线机器 online/total and 在线编队 online/total from the primary relay healthz counters, with the server machine ratio in the tooltip and — for unavailable data
assertions.proof: client-bundle 43/43 (parser cases + watcher/status invariants), real Chromium loader-entry 10/10, claims/layer-model/gpw-ai 84 pass, eslint 0 errors
